E6 · Benefits & Assets

the Benefit model and realisation ledger: what value each verb and Element claims, with evidence and realisation state

Purpose

Bind every claimed Benefit to evidence and an explicit realisation condition.

Strategy

Technical output is never labelled Benefit realisation; realisation is declared only when its written condition is met under authority.

Assets

The Benefit model (B1-B5), realisation conditions and the realisation ledger.

Mesh participation (all nine stages)

1 Signal — What EntersBenefit claims and realisation evidence arriving from completed verb cycles.
2 InterpretationWhether a claim is output, contribution, or realised Benefit.
3 StructuringBenefit entries with baseline, target, evidence source and realisation test.
4 ValidationEvidence-binding checks; realisation declarations remain HELD to Steward authority.
5 Action PermittedRecord contributions; stage realisation candidates for Steward declaration.
6 ObservationWhether declared conditions are approached over successive cycles.
7 LearningWhich Benefit definitions are measurable and which need redesign.
8 Asset ConversionRealised, repeatable Benefits with stable evidence chains qualify toward Assets.
9 Feedback Returns ToRealisation gaps feed back to Project as objective-setting Signals.
